business_summary: Northeast Electric Development Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of products related to power transmission and transformation equipment in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Production and Sales of Power Transmission Equipment and Related Accessories; Hotel Operations and Provision of Related Catering Services; and Investment Holding segments. The company offers enclosed busbar products. It is also involved in hotel catering and accommodation services; manufacturing of electrical equipment; hotel business; and provision of electric power engineering services. The company was formerly known as Northeast Electricity Transmitting & Transformation Machinery Manufacturing Ltd. Northeast Electric Development Company Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Haikou, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Northeast Electric Development Company Limited는 중화인민공화국에서 송전 및 변전 장비와 관련된 제품의 연구, 설계, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사합니다. 동력 전달 장비 및 관련 액세서리의 생산 및 판매를 통해 운영됩니다. 호텔 운영 및 관련 케이터링 서비스 제공 및 투자 보유 부문. 이 회사는 밀폐형 부스바 제품을 제공합니다. 또한 호텔 케이터링 및 숙박 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 전기 장비 제조; 호텔사업; 전력 엔지니어링 서비스 제공. 이 회사의 이전 명칭은 Northeast Electricity Transmitting & Transformation Machinery Manufacturing Ltd.입니다. Northeast Electric Development Company Limited는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중화인민공화국 하이커우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
